[SWS_CM_12012] Subscription State change handler
⌈
The handler Sub-
scriptionStateChangeHandler defined in [SWS_CM_00311], [SWS_CM_12008] and
[SWS_CM_12009] shall be called by the Communication Management implementa-
tion as soon as the subscription state of this event has changed. Handler may be
overwritten during runtime.
⌋
